title: Find the right part of the document
summary: The search behind a staff Q&A bot keeps returning the wrong text. Fix chunking and ranking.
hints: Split on the ## headings first. A section is a natural chunk. Only split a long section further, at sentence or paragraph ends.
Score chunks by word overlap, but ignore common words like 'the', 'how', 'do', and lower-case everything.
Rare words matter more than common ones. Try TF-IDF or BM25: weight each word by how few chunks contain it. Also match simple word forms, like 'refunds' and 'refund'.
